sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:27

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:27:1
items.html: The seven lower [Sefirot] of Atik Yomin that clothed in the seven corrections of the Galgalta of AA: As explained above — that for the second Ibur, of the Mochin of the internality, ZA must attain the discernment of the HGT of Atik that are transformed and become HBD; and this applies only where the seven lower [Sefirot] of Atik are clothed in the seven corrections of the Galgalta, for there they bestow the discernment of HBD, and then he receives the Mochin of GAR of the internality.
